name: @metaharness/oo-agents
description: Object-oriented agents with a Rust/WASM code-as-action sandbox — a TypeScript clone of NOOA (NVIDIA-NeMo/labs-OO-Agents): the agent is a class; fields are state, methods are capabilities, docs are prompts, schemas are contracts, and the model acts by writing code in a fuel-limited wasm cell VM.
